title: Text that belongs to the scene no longer refuses an owner photo; words written on the photo still do
steps: S1: In the TCH checkout with dependencies installed, run run.cmd (no database needed).
S2: Confirm both tests named in run.tests report ok.
expect: A photo labelled textPresence present with hasTextOrWatermark false and hasTextOverlay false is usable (photoRefusal null).
The same photo with hasTextOrWatermark true, or hasTextOverlay true, is refused as 'lettering or a watermark'.
The picture check P09 passes the scene-text photo and fails the two lettered variants with 'carries lettering or a watermark'.

tests: scene text survives brief mapping and does not refuse a photo; words on the photo itself still do (P09)
P09 passes text that belongs to the scene and fails words written on the photo itself
